[[File:Astrogation-Officer-TCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] astrogation officer]]
'''Astrogation''', also known as '''astronavigation''', was the science of navigating [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Two tasks defined astrogation: determining present location, and planning a safe and reliable means of reaching a destination. The former was performed by those skilled in [[astrocartography]], familiar with star patterns or automata. Astronav charts mapped areas of space and could be used to plot courses through hyperspace. The plotting of a course was generally handled exclusively by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] or [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]].

The knowledge of one's whereabouts in space and other celestial objects was vital to navigating hyperspace, as incorrectly calculated jumps meant a ship could collide with a planet, star, or other body.

==Description==
Astrogation was the process of plotting a course for a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] between two [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. The time it took to calculate a route using a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] varied depending on several factors. It could take as little as a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] if the vessel's position was known, and the course was along a commonly traveled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to a previously charted destination. Travelling from a known position to one that had not previously been travelled to could take a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] for the navigation computer to calculate the coordinates. In situations where the vessel's position was unknown, it could take around a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] for the navigation computer to plot the starship's position and then calculate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Astrogation is an original sci-fi word which means "star navigation." Since etymologically and historically the part "navi-" refers to terrestrial ships, it has been replaced by the prefix "astro-."
